story.title: Pip's Magic Word

panels.desc: A round riddle room inside the castle with a high domed ceiling. All around the walls hang gold picture frames, each showing one picture from the friends' journey: a red cape, a red kite, a coiled rope, a red toy cube, a pink cake, a pine tree, a white bone and a silver flute. Bun walks along the wall pointing at each frame and reading; Hedgie follows, counting on his paw; Beads rides on Hedgie's flower; Pip hops behind; Fairy E flies from frame to frame making each one twinkle. Hidden in the picture: the cape, the kite, the rope, the cube. Grumble does NOT appear. No letters anywhere.
panels.ko: 성 안 수수께끼 방이에요. 벽마다 그동안 바꾼 그림들이 금빛 액자에 걸려 있어요. 모두 하나씩 읽어 봐요.

panels.desc: At the far side of the riddle room stands a tall golden door with one last riddle: a wooden sign carved with three letters c, a, p — these three letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture — and a blue baseball cap hanging on a hook below it. Fairy E tries to tap the sign, but her star wand only gives a tiny fizzle and she yawns, tired. Pip stands alone in front of the cap with its eyes squeezed shut and feathers trembling, beak open, trying with all its might; Bun and Hedgie hold their breath with paws over their mouths; Beads holds up three beads one at a time. Hidden in the picture: a walking cane leaning by the door, a roll of tape on the floor, a little potted pine, a bone. Grumble does NOT appear.

lines.ko: 딸깍딸깍! 넌 할 수 있어, 핍!

panels.ko: 마지막 금빛 문에 다시 파란 모자가 걸려 있어요. 요정 이의 지팡이는 지쳐서 반짝이지 않아요. 핍이 눈을 꼭 감고 애써요.

ask.en: What is on the last door?

panels.desc: Pip has said its first magic word: it stands tall with its beak wide open, glowing bright gold, and a wave of sparkles bursts from its beak onto the door: a sparkling letter e appears all by itself at the end of the wooden sign, so it reads c a p e — these four letters are the ONLY text allowed in the picture — and the blue cap below swirls into a red cape, no wand needed. The tall golden door swings open with light pouring out. Fairy E zooms around Pip cheering, her star wand twinkling again; Bun and Hedgie jump and cheer with arms up; Beads clicks all its beads in a happy arc. Hidden in the picture: the cape, the open golden gate, a note fluttering in the air, a cute mule peeking in.
panels.ko: "케이프!" 핍의 첫 마법 단어예요! 지팡이 없이도 c-a-p 끝에 e 가 저절로 붙어 모자가 망토로 바뀌고 금빛 문이 열려요. 모두 환호해요.

panels.desc: Dusk light shines through the open golden door. Behind it a long spiral staircase of stone steps winds up into the tall towers. Grumble has come down from his window and stands at the bottom of the stairs in his blue robe, holding his lantern up so its warm glow lights the steps; his little drum hangs at his side; he whispers with a tiny smile. Bun waves at him; Hedgie and Beads start up the steps; Pip glows softly on Bun's head; Fairy E sits on Grumble's nightcap. Hidden in the picture: Grumble's robe, the stone steps, a red rose by the stairs, a globe. No letters anywhere.

lines.text: Up, up, up the stone steps!

panels.ko: 해질녘, 그럼블이 창문에서 내려와 등불로 계단을 비춰 줘요. 작게 "케이프" 하고 속삭여요. 모두 탑 계단을 올라가요.

story.synopsis_ko: 성 안 수수께끼 방 벽에 그동안 바꾼 그림들이 걸려 있어요. 마지막 금빛 문에 다시 파란 모자가 걸려 있는데 요정 이의 지팡이가 지쳐 반짝이지 않아요. 핍이 온 힘을 다해 "케이프!" 하고 첫 마법 단어를 말하자 모자가 저절로 망토로 바뀌고 문이 열려요! 그럼블이 내려와 등불로 계단을 비춰 줘요.
story.so_far_ko: 욕조가 튜브가 되어 모래 언덕 방으로 갔어요. 노새가 플루트를 불고 그럼블이 몰래 북을 쳤어요.
story.goal_ko: 마법 e 단어를 복습하고 핍의 첫 마법 단어를 들어요.

videos.prompt: Gentle picture-book animation: the baby bird opens its beak and bursts into golden light, a wave of sparkles flies onto the blue cap which swirls into a red cape by itself, the tall golden door swings open with light pouring out, the tiny fairy and the friends cheer. Camera still. Joyful, child-friendly. No text.

Gentle picture-book animation: the old raccoon in a blue robe raises his lantern and its warm glow spreads up a spiral stone staircase step by step, the friends wave and start climbing, the tiny fairy sits on his nightcap. Camera slowly tilts up the stairs. Calm, warm, child-friendly. No text.

lines.text: Drip, drop! Drip, drop! Oh no!
